scope: Next-round CPU dataset preparation only; no GPU updates or candidate retuning after v5 heldout.
layout_basis: Chosen from v5 dev before any v5 heldout gold read; fixes train/serving layout mismatch.
train_sources: Frozen v4train21 plus independently approved v6train25, eight documents total.
dev_sources: The eight hash-assigned dev documents from reader-v6-next-balanced-drafts.
heldout_sources: The eight hash-assigned heldout documents from reader-v6-next-balanced-drafts.
evaluation_case_policy: Four manually judged cases per document, normally two positive and two same-topic unsupported; no forced citation-only position labels.
next_heldout_is_not_a_blind_human_benchm: Data author/reviewer see labels during construction; future model training/evaluation must keep heldout files outside training processes.
